original_test_intent: Validate every Type 44 Referenced Handle as a same-table link to the intended Type 4 processor, while allowing multiple independently valid Type 44 blocks for one processor and legitimate handle renumbering across reboot.
original_method: Length-check Type 44, decode raw offset-04h WORD, resolve it through the complete table to Type 4, bind target content to approved socket/topology identity, validate multi-block grouping and repeat after reboot using semantic rather than numeric continuity.
manual_activity: A user supplies processor topology/multi-block policy and approves reboot; handle graph validation is automated and read-only.
required_inputs: Allowed multiple Type 44 blocks per processor and processor-specific format map
Complete raw table parser and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not offline/online CPUs, modify topology, write firmware or use handles as action targets.
Require the referenced target to exist in the same table and be Type 4.
Allow multiple Type 44 sources only when each block is structurally valid and mapped to the approved processor.
Stop on CPU/management health loss; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode/reference-resolve every handle, verify Type4 target and semantic processor identity, group valid multiple blocks and diff associations across reboot.
Report dangling, wrong-type, cross-processor, conflicting duplicate or unexplained identity changes without verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve processor identity/topology, multi-block formats and reboot plan.
Adjudicate intentional topology/firmware changes and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove raw offset, target existence/type, processor ownership or valid multi-block relationships.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw Type 4/44 and emit source handle, referenced WORD, resolved Type4 identity/topology, multi-block group and pre/post semantic mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Referenced Handle scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no exact numeric stability or CPU action is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve every raw Type 44 reference to Type 4, bind it to a semantic socket/topology identity, validate allowed multi-block grouping and compare mappings across reboot independent of handle numbers.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 44 and Type 4.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, CPU/BIOS, parser/dmidecode and OS inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 44 Referenced Handle and Type 4 Processor Information definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds type-safe graph resolution, processor ownership and valid one-to-many semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects dangling/wrong-type/cross-processor links without falsely rejecting multiple blocks or handle renumbering.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Content identity must be strong enough to distinguish identical processors in different sockets; handle value alone is insufficient.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define multiple processor-specific Type 44 blocks and cross-boot handle policy, but cannot validate a missing/wrong-type target or change CPU state under this case.
expected_evidence: Approved Type4 socket/topology and Type44 multi-block map
Complete pre/post raw Type4/44 handles, lengths and referenced WORDs
Per-Type44 type-safe resolution and semantic processor identity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Referenced Handle is a valid Type 44 cross-reference; Type4 resolution and multi-block semantics preserve its purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Graph resolution/topology comparison are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw offset, Type4 target, semantic processor identity and one-to-many block validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-handle-stability/no-CPU-change safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates topology/reboot inputs and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Avoids accepting any existing handle, while also avoiding the false one-Type44-per-processor and exact-cross-boot-handle assumptions.
independent_technical_reasoning: This field is a typed graph edge from an additional-information block to its processor; validity requires same-table target type, semantic ownership and allowed edge multiplicity.
